sketch.name: HedgeCoverageMeter
sketch.description: A hedge coverage meter: for each future month the percent of expected exposure that is hedged (futures plus fixed-price physical), as bars against a shaded policy band, with the weighted coverage and the months out of policy.
sketch.html: weighted, next 12 months

props.name: title
props.description: The label above the weighted coverage.

props.name: unit
props.description: The volume unit shown in the tooltip.

props.name: policyMin
props.description: Lower edge of the policy band, in percent.

props.name: policyMax
props.description: Upper edge of the policy band, in percent.

props.name: selected
props.description: The selected month (its Month text); empty for none.

props.name: months
props.description: The months, nearest first: month, exposure, futures, physical.
